toegepas.na: wys 'n liniaal wat oor 'n tafelrand uitsteek ook
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'n Liniaal oor 'n tafelrand' is compressed and unclear; saying the ruler sticks out over the edge makes the picture clear without adding content.
toegepas.fout: 'n liniaal oor 'n tafelrand' is compressed: it does not say that part of the ruler sticks out, which is what 'n korter stuk' refers to.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Saying that the ruler sticks out over the table edge makes the familiar demonstration clear to a Grade 4 reader, and it keeps the same preposition, the same claim and the same subject.

laat_vaar.blok: Hoog en laag, hard en sag
laat_vaar.voor: Hoog of laag is die vierde van vier ewe goeie vrae
laat_vaar.na: "Is dit hoog of laag?" is die vierde van vier ewe goeie vrae
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: The sentence calls 'hoog of laag' a question, so writing it as the actual question reads more naturally and clearly for a Grade 4 learner.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: Calling 'hoog of laag' one of the sorting questions is acceptable shorthand that follows on naturally from the sentences before it, and the proposal adds quotation marks and a question mark to a lesson that holds no questions, so it is only a different way of saying the same thing and adds clutter.

laat_vaar_vorige.voor: speel hulle xilofone wat hulle timbila noem
laat_vaar_vorige.na: speel xilofone wat hulle timbila noem
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: The double 'hulle' (possessive, then subject) is clumsy; the possessive adds nothing.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: The possessive 'hulle xilofone' carries that these are the Chopi's own instruments, set against the school marimba just before; dropping it loses that and the original reads acceptably.

laat_vaar_vorige.blok: Praat oor julle eie en mekaar se optredes
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: 'Karakters bou' calques English 'build characters'; Afrikaans creates (skep) a character.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'Karakters bou' (building up a character) is accepted drama usage in Afrikaans and may echo the curriculum's wording; 'skep' narrows developing to creating, a lateral move at best.

laat_vaar_vorige.voor: wat in die middel van jou rug loop.
laat_vaar_vorige.na: wat langs die middel van jou rug af loop.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: 'In die middel van jou rug loop' can read as walking; 'langs ... af loop' is the idiom for something running down the back.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: The ruggraat definition is protected word for word as a shared definition, and 'loop' for something running along the back is ordinary Afrikaans.
